text:
jamal: Quick ping — PR #2571 is mostly ready but CI is failing on a tiny style nits. Two things: odd indent in a multi-line struct literal and inconsistent initialism casing (we have `KmsKey` in one place and `KMSKey` elsewhere). PTAL when you have a minute.

maria: on it, can you paste the snippet? small threads like this are easiest to fix inline.

jamal: pasted below:
```go
client := &Client{
    cfg: Config{
        Endpoint: endpoint,
         Credentials: creds, // <- extra space before field name
    },
    kmsKey: fmt.Sprintf("%s", key), // note: uses `kmsKey` / `KmsKey` elsewhere
}
```

alex: yea that indent looks off (extra space before `Credentials`). also we try to use `KMSKey` for the acronym per our style guide (initialisms uppercased). run `gofumpt -w` and `sed` or a quick rename.

ci-bot: build failed — `gofumpt` check failed; golangci-lint also flagged `initialisms` rule: kms vs KMS.

jamal: pushed a tiny fix: normalized to `KMSKey`, removed the stray space, and ran `gofumpt -w`. also updated a single unit test name that referenced the old field. rerunning CI now.

alex: nice. if CI is green we can merge during the next merge window. thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

maria: quick note for future: small followups like this are fine in a single commit, but if you touch public structs call out migration notes in the PR description. no blockers here.

jamal: noted — will add a short line in the PR description after merge. thanks all.
